377YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.d: On Friday the Conclave added the Cuckoo's Egg ritual, which lets non-citizens pass through the Sentinel Gate, to Imperial Lore and appointed Vaan of Auric Horizon as Warmage from eight candidates. On Saturday Evander Slack and Alex Lansdale of Bregasland were declared sorcerers, a Vallorn ritual was interdicted and Concordia became Conclave Liaison to the Senate. On Sunday a declaration of enmity against Carolinos Kade failed and drake's eggs were interdicted. Approved gambits funded war magic, including a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Karsk, Winter's Ghosts on Reikos and battlefield healing against the Druj in the Barrens. Others funded scrying into the heart of Bas Celik and gifts to appease Kimus.

n.Dawn: Mentioned in passing: the Archmage of Spring had approved funding to cast Shadowed Glass of Sung to investigate the Spring Herald in Dawn.
n.Druj: The Conclave directed magic against the Druj. It funded Winter's Ghosts on Druj-held Reikos and battlefield healing for Imperial forces engaging the Druj in the Barrens.
n.Thule: The Archmage of Spring sought help with a plan to turn the forces of Llofir against the Thule rather than the Empire. The Conclave also approved raising a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Thule-held Karsk.

t.Karsk: The Archmage of Summer won Conclave approval to raise a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Karsk, then held by the Thule.
t.Reikos: The Archmage of Autumn received 20 mana to perform Winter's Ghosts on Druj-held Reikos.
t.The Barrens: The Archmage of Night received mana to provide battlefield healing for the Sunday engagement against the Druj in the Barrens.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: The Highborn invited all citizens to a candlelit procession remembering the fallen, followed by the Day of Rebirth. The League revived the Masquerade of the Reaper, with masks, competitions, a parade with a burning effigy and a grand party. A delegation from the Chambers of Issyk in Axos docked at Crown Quay in Necropolis and travelled to Anvil seeking parley and trade. The Magistrates stressed that the Axou were protected by Imperial law. Astronomancers foresaw a conjunction of the Three Sisters, last seen before Empress Giselle's death and the final retreat from Holberg, marking a winter of blood-ties and sorrow. The mercenary Iron Raptors, under Master Aryton Scalmere, offered dangerous contracts.

n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but the page recalls the final Imperial retreat from Holberg, a territory they held at the time.
n.Highguard: The Highborn invited citizens of every nation to their camp for the Day of the Dead, a procession and stories honouring the fallen, followed by the Day of Rebirth. Escon, the Highborn egregore, was named as the one to answer questions about the tradition.
n.The League: The League revived the Masquerade of the Reaper, with masks, Bridge Fighting, the Hunt of Ambition, a cartas' remembrance and a parade with a burning effigy. A grand party in the League plaza followed.
n.Varushka: Mentioned in passing: the starwatchers of Void in Volodmartz were among those who agreed that a conjunction of the Three Sisters was coming.

t.Holberg: Mentioned in passing: the last major conjunction of the Three Sisters was recalled as occurring shortly before the final retreat from Holberg.
t.Necropolis: The crimson-sailed ship of the Axou delegation from the Chambers of Issyk docked at Crown Quay in Necropolis. The delegation then travelled overland to Anvil under a scarlet flag.
t.Volodmartz: Mentioned in passing: the starwatchers of Void in snow-dusted Volodmartz confirmed the coming conjunction of the Three Sisters.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: Imperial forces made progress in Holberg and Karsk, where the retreating Thule salted the earth. The Summer Storm drove the last Thule out of Skarsind into Otkodov, leaving devastation and restless dead behind. In Casinea and Bastion, Dawnish, Highborn and Navarr armies prepared to strike east into Druj-held lands. The ceasefire with the Jotun held in the west despite raiding by hot-heads on both sides. Rumours spoke of Lasambrian orcs moving north into Liathaven and of Druj slipping into eastern Therunin. In Segura the Red Wind Corsairs were slowly pushed back while the Lasambrians rose. In northern Hercynia, Harak the Red mustered Thulish auxiliaries and bandits for an unknown purpose.

n.Druj: The Druj were being driven back in Holberg, while their territories around Haros Water and Broken Ridge faced an imminent Imperial offensive. A Druj force out of High Chalcis was rumoured to be slipping into Therunin.
n.Highguard: Highborn armies gathered in Casinea and Bastion alongside Dawnish and Navarr forces, ready to drive east and reclaim the lands stolen from the Highborn.
n.Jotun: The ceasefire between the Jotun and the Empire held, with the borders observed by both sides' generals despite raids by enthusiasts on each side.
n.Navarr: Navarr armies stood ready to strike east against the Druj, but the weakened Navarr in Liathaven faced Lasambrian orcs moving north. Eastern Therunin was threatened by Druj incursions.
n.Thule: The Thule fell back in Karsk, salting the earth as they went, and fled Skarsind into Otkodov to regroup. Thulish auxiliaries also gathered under Harak the Red in Hercynia's Glen of Shadows.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: the passes of Urizen's Morrow are described as eastern Therunin's precarious connection to the Empire.
n.Wintermark: Skarsind was freed from Thule occupation by the Summer Storm, though the returning Winterfolk found devastation and restless dead. The shield of Wintermark also helped push the Thule back in Karsk.

t.Bastion: Imperial forces massed in Bastion, ready to sweep east and reclaim Highborn lands from the Druj.
t.Casinea: Dawnish, Highborn and Navarr armies stood ready in Casinea to drive a spear into the heart of the Druj.
t.Hercynia: In northern Hercynia, the isolated orcs of the Glen of Shadows lit their war beacons and gathered under Harak the Red for an unknown purpose.
t.Holberg: The tide turned in Holberg as Imperial forces drove the Druj back, and its people could once again stand on their walls.
t.Karsk: The Thule fell back in Karsk before Marcher, Wintermark and Varushkan armies, salting the earth wherever they could.
t.Liathaven: A ceasefire with the Jotun held in Liathaven, but Lasambrian orcs were rumoured to be moving north to exploit the weakness of the last Navarr there.
t.Morrow: Mentioned in passing: the passes of Morrow are described as eastern Therunin's precarious link to the rest of the Empire.
t.Otkodov: The Thule armies driven out of Skarsind retreated across the mountains into Otkodov to lick their wounds and prepare their next assault.
t.Reikos: Druj-held Reikos lay in the path of the Imperial armies massing to the west, and whispers of "Soon" were heard at Haros Water and Broken Ridge.
t.Segura: The Red Wind Corsairs were slowly being pushed back in Segura, while the Freeborn army there barely held against two armies as the Lasambrian Hills grew stronger.
t.Skarsind: The last Thule forces were driven from Skarsind by the Summer Storm, but the returning Winterfolk found devastation, a lingering taint and restless dead.
t.Therunin: Eastern Therunin, connected to the Empire only by the passes of Morrow, faced rumours of Druj raiders crossing into Peakedge Song and creeping through the Tarn.

r.Hercynia/The Glen of Shadows: The isolated orcs of the Glen of Shadows lit their war beacons and gathered under Harak the Red's banners, but made no move north or south.
r.Liathaven/Beacon Point: Rumours spoke of a well-armed mob of Lasambrian orcs moving north towards Beacon Point.
r.Liathaven/Western Scout: Western Scout was rumoured to be a target for Lasambrian orcs moving north to exploit Navarr weakness.
r.Reikos/Broken Ride: Unseen voices whispering "Soon" were heard through the ghost-haunted glades of Broken Ridge as Imperial armies prepared to strike.
r.Reikos/Haros Water: Winter winds howled across the walls of Haros Water while Imperial forces readied to sweep eastward.
r.Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley: Druj scouts were rumoured to be sneaking through the marshes of Lower Tarn, bringing fire and poison.
r.Therunin/Peakedge Song: A Druj force out of High Chalcis was rumoured to be slinking over the borders into Peakedge Song.

Archive:377YE Winter Solstice Imperial t.d: Every Imperial territory had a sitting senator, with Wintermark's four seats among them. Gideon of the Suns of Couros served as Conscience of the Senate and Irontide Bruc as Advisor on Orc Affairs. Several armies changed generals: Anwar i Covas i Erigo took the Fire of the South, Gabriel Barossa the Wolves of War, Gwai the Quiet Step and Bloodcrow Martok the Winter Sun (marked TBC). Cardinals and gatekeepers were named for each virtue assembly, six Archmagi were declared, and Bourse seats were allocated with their winning bids. The Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund remained in Druj hands and would not be auctioned until those territories returned to the Empire.

n.Dawn: Dawn held three Senate seats and kept its generals Floree de Rondell, Clarence Oswald and Frederick Novarion. Agnetha De Rondell served as Cardinal of Wisdom.
n.Druj: The Druj held the Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund, so these Bourse seats were withheld from auction until the territories return to Imperial hands.
n.Highguard: Highguard held three Senate seats, kept generals Matthias and Ruth, and supplied the Cardinals of Courage, Loyalty and Pride. It also supplied the Gatekeeper of Vigilance and the Grandmaster of the Sevenfold Path.
n.Imperial Orcs: Bloodcrow Martok was recorded as replacing Klor of the Winter Sun (marked TBC), Braka kept the Summer Storm, and Bruk held the Steel Fist.
n.Navarr: Gwai replaced Kale Vigil as general of the Quiet Step, while Navarr also held three Senate seats and the Gatekeepers of Pride and Wisdom. Meir Pathfinder was Grandmaster of the Rod and Shield and Idris Eternal held the Thimble.
n.The Brass Coast: Anwar i Covas i Erigo replaced Yasmina I Ezmara I Erigo as general of the Fire of the South. The Brass Coast also held three Senate seats, the Gatekeeper of Prosperity, the Grandmaster of the Golden Pyramid and the Broken Shore Bounty.
n.The League: Gabriel Barossa replaced Stanislav Krieger van Temeschwar at the head of the Wolves of War. League citizens held the Cardinals of Ambition and Prosperity, the Quartermaster General, the Bursar of the Conclave, the Imperial Mint and many Bourse seats.
n.The Marches: The Marches held three Senate seats and kept generals Richard Talbot, Jack Flint and William Tanner. Friar Alan Young remained Gatekeeper of Loyalty.
n.Urizen: Urizen held three Senate seats and kept Tanwyn Ankarien as general of the Citadel Guard. Cyrus Cascade served as Gatekeeper of Courage and Marcus of Endsmeet held the Legacy.
n.Varushka: Varushka held three Senate seats, two generals and the Cardinal of Vigilance. Its people also held two Conclave Grandmasterships, the Dean of the Lyceum, and the Eternal Shafts of Time and the Granites of Veltsgorsk.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark held four Senate seats and kept generals Vahne and Erkenbrand of Tyrsholm. Joakim held the Stonefield Ice Caves.

t.Astolat: Bohemond De Rondell served as Senator for Astolat.
t.Bastion: Solomon served as Senator for Bastion.
t.Bregasland: Orrick served as Senator for Bregasland, the Dour Fens.
t.Casinea: Zephram of Cantiarch's Hold served as Senator for Casinea.
t.Feroz: Sallur I Mnajdra I Guerra served as Senator for Feroz.
t.Hahnmark: Hengest Dun served as Senator for Hahnmark.
t.Hercynia: Rhain served as Senator for Hercynia.
t.Holberg: Holberg remained under the Druj, so the Great Pits of Ennerlund would not be auctioned until it is once again Imperial.
t.Kahraman: Rauul i Jannat i Requiza served as Senator for Kahraman.
t.Kallavesa: Uskolli served as Senator for Kallavesa.
t.Karov: Constantin served as Senator for Karov.
t.Madruga: Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra served as Senator for Madruga.
t.Miaren: Rhys served as Senator for Miaren.
t.Miekarova: Radomir served as Senator for Miekarova.
t.Mitwold: Bridget Eastville (née Talbot) served as Senator for Mitwold, Pride of the Marches.
t.Morrow: Lucius of Quicksilver Spire served as Senator for Morrow.
t.Necropolis: Adamah of the Silent Tide served as Senator for Necropolis.
t.Redoubt: Probus served as Senator for Redoubt.
t.Reikos: The Great Forest at Reikos was held by the Druj and would not be auctioned until Reikos is again an Imperial territory.
t.Sarvos: Mirislav served as Senator for Sarvos.
t.Semmerholm: Ywain De Gauvain served as Senator for Semmerholm.
t.Sermersuaq: Atte served as Senator for Sermersuaq.
t.Skarsind: Triva of Tyrshalt served as Senator for Skarsind.
t.Tassato: Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato served as Senator for Tassato.
t.Temeschwar: Drogon Morosini served as Senator for Temeschwar.
t.Therunin: Caerwyn Summer Crow served as Senator for Therunin.
t.Upwold: Henry Ward served as Senator for Upwold, the Silver Chase.
t.Volodmartz: Vitomyr Krasiludovich Antonov served as Senator for Volodmartz.
t.Weirwater: Lady Adia of House Arwood served as Senator for Weirwater. The Weirwater Vales Bourse seat went to Niccolo dos Tassatos for 98 Thrones.
t.Zenith: Cato served as Senator for Zenith.

r.Holberg/Ennerlund: The Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by the Druj and would not be auctioned until Holberg is once again an Imperial territory.

Construct Asavean Embassy.d: The motion passed in principle by 22 votes to 2 and at 35 Thrones by 18 to 6, but failed at 40 Thrones. The commission carried an unusual cost of 20 white granite and 20 weirwood, which Mirislav, Senator for Sarvos, supplied after the Spring Equinox 378YE. An amendment proposed by Miaren and seconded by Weirwater disbursed a further 5 Thrones to Senator Miaren to buy white granite. The completed embassy became a ministry, allowing its appointed citizen to purchase Cerulean Mazzarine, Orichalcum, Iridescent Gloaming, Tempest Jade and True Vervain. The title of ambassador to the Asavean Archipelago was created automatically.

n.The League: The League gained a formal embassy to the Asavean Archipelago in one of its cities, along with a ministry trading in rare Asavean materials. Sarvos's own senator, Mirislav, supplied the stone and timber needed to build it.

t.Sarvos: The Asavean embassy was built in Sarvos, making the city the site of the Empire's diplomatic and trading link with the Archipelago. Its senator, Mirislav, proposed the motion and provided the 20 wains of white granite and weirwood.

Construct Jarmish Embassy.d: Proposed by Sermersuaq's senator and seconded by Upwold's, the motion carried in principle 27–0 and passed at 40 Thrones by 23–4; a 45 Throne cost failed. The non-standard cost of 20 white granite and 20 weirwood was provided by Atte, Senator for Sermersuaq, after the Summer Solstice 378YE. Although the embassy was built in Cargo, the House of Princes refused to name an ambassador until the Senate chose which Jarmish port would host the reciprocal Imperial embassy. The embassy is a ministry letting its Imperial operator buy crystal mana, dragonbone, ambergelt, green iron, iridescent gloaming, cerulean mazzarine and marrowort. Oswi Twice-Burned was appointed Ambassador to Jarm at the Autumn Equinox 378YE.

n.Urizen: The Jarmish embassy was built on Urizen land at Cargo in Redoubt, giving the nation's territory a new diplomatic and trading link with the Principalities of Jarm.

t.Redoubt: Cargo in Redoubt became the site of the Jarmish embassy, a ministry through which rare materials such as dragonbone, ambergelt and crystal mana can be bought.

Disburse funds for mithril research.d: Proposed by the senator for Redoubt and seconded by Astolat, the motion asked for 34 thrones towards research by the Provost of the Halls of Knowledge into raising mithril output in Redoubt, plus a further 10 thrones to make the results part of Imperial Lore. It passed unanimously in principle and at 34 thrones (27 to 0), but failed at 44 thrones (10 to 17). The funds were disbursed to Senator Redoubt. Preliminary research found that ritual magic cannot be used to improve the production of mithril, white granite, weirwood or ilium.

n.Urizen: Urizen's senator for Redoubt proposed and received funding to research boosting the nation's mithril production, but the research concluded that ritual magic cannot improve it.

t.Redoubt: The research aimed to increase mithril production in Redoubt, but preliminary findings showed that ritual magic cannot raise the territory's mithril output.

Fortify Ateri in Spiral.d: Acting under the Senate's legal power to raise fortifications, the Imperial Master of Works approved finishing the partial fortification at Ateri in Spiral, known as Fort Mezudan. The work required 25 wains of white granite and a season to build, with upkeep of 10 Thrones. Marcus of Endsmeet Autumn Coven supplied the full 25 wains of white granite after the Winter Solstice 377YE, and the fortification was completed. Two years later, at the Autumn Equinox 379YE, a powerful magical storm struck the fortress and destroyed it completely.

n.Grendel: Fort Mezudan was finished in Spiral, a territory Grendel shared control of that season. The page does not mention Grendel directly.
n.Urizen: The Empire completed Fort Mezudan in Spiral, a Urizen territory that Urizen shared with Grendel that season. Its later destruction in 379YE removed this Imperial stronghold from the territory.

t.Spiral: Spiral gained a completed fortification, Fort Mezudan, which stood until a magical storm destroyed it at the Autumn Equinox 379YE.

r.Spiral/Ateri: Ateri was the site of Fort Mezudan, completed from a partial fortification after Winter 377YE and wholly destroyed by a powerful magical storm in Autumn 379YE.

Fortify Golden Downs in Mitwold.d: The motion to create a fortification in Mitwold was approved by the Imperial Master of Works rather than by a Senate vote. The standard cost was 100 wains of white granite and a year of construction, with an upkeep of 10 Thrones. Richard Tunstall, Imperial Master of Works, supplied all of the granite himself in four instalments of 25 wains, after the Winter Solstice 377YE and the Spring Equinox, Summer Solstice and Autumn Equinox of 378YE. Construction of the fortification, named Forte Fidelis, was completed.

n.The Marches: The Marches gained a new fortification, Forte Fidelis, strengthening the defence of their territory of Mitwold.

t.Mitwold: Mitwold gained a completed fortification, Forte Fidelis, built over a year from 100 wains of white granite and requiring 10 Thrones in upkeep.

r.Mitwold/Golden Downs: Golden Downs became the site of Forte Fidelis, a new fortification whose construction was completed after the Autumn Equinox 378YE.

Repair the docks at Caricomare.d: Proposed by the senator for Temeschwar and seconded by the senator for Sarvos, the motion sought to repair the Caricomare Quays, a ruined great work at the docks of Sarvos. The repairs were costed at 35 white granite and 5 weirwood. Had they been carried out, every League fleet operating out of Sarvos would have produced more wealth, with a total benefit of 480 rings per season shared among all fleets active there. The Senate rejected the motion in principle, 10 votes for and 14 against, so the quays remained in ruins.

n.The League: League senators for Temeschwar and Sarvos championed the repair, but its defeat denied League fleet captains working out of Sarvos an extra 480 rings per season to share between them.

t.Sarvos: The Caricomare Quays at Sarvos stayed ruined after the Senate voted down their restoration, leaving the territory's fleets without the added wealth the repaired docks would have brought.
